evidence.label: production-local
evidence.note: Production build. Programmatic DOM input only; no OS input, paint, compositing, or hot-sample checkpoint drain included.

boundaries.coldEnd: first requestAnimationFrame poll tick that observes terminal.store.ready, loading=false, cursor>0, a non-null account, and every visible [data-pane] canvas last completed clearRect with lastDrawCursor equal to terminal.cursor
boundaries.hotStart: window capture-phase click timestamp for HTMLElement.click() on the real toolbar button inside a Playwright locator.evaluate() task
boundaries.hotEnd: start of the next requestAnimationFrame callback after the draw callback that cleared every visible [data-pane] canvas with terminal.cursor equal to the post-step/control target
boundaries.syncWork: timestamp immediately after HTMLElement.click() returns minus its window capture timestamp, in the same JavaScript task; includes synchronous event dispatch and handlers, excludes Vue render microtasks, browser/OS input delivery, and IndexedDB checkpoint drain
boundaries.chartCallbackCpu: sum of instrumented requestAnimationFrame callback durations that called CanvasRenderingContext2D.clearRect in the event window; excludes Vue render microtasks, WASM analysis computation outside those callbacks, paint, compositing, and GPU work
boundaries.stepCursor: terminal.cursor after minus terminal.cursor before must equal exactly 1
boundaries.account: terminal.account must remain non-null and startBalance must be unchanged

method.input: programmatic DOM HTMLElement.click() on real toolbar buttons, via Playwright locator.evaluate(); no pointer/keyboard or OS-level input is claimed
method.settling: each hot sample waits for a condition-based chart-idle check (three consecutive RAF polls with no new canvas draw) before the next sample; no fixed sleeps are used
method.staleDraws: draw frames are eligible only if they started at or after the click event and report the target terminal.cursor after their callback; TA-on samples additionally require the draw-time analysis toggle to be enabled and status ready, so an old, pre-toggle chart draw cannot satisfy the measurement
method.coldData: fresh browser context per sample; synthetic settings cookie and localStorage; no private data
method.hotData: one fresh browser context for all hot scenarios; synthetic settings cookie and localStorage; no private data
method.checkpoint: cold readiness includes the app initial checkpoint because store.ready flips only after createCheckpoint resolves; hot step response does not await queueCheckpoint() (IndexedDB drain is excluded)
excluded: browser input queue latency before the DOM click event
IndexedDB checkpoint drain during hot samples
